entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The instant bail cancellation application has been moved on behalf of the informant for cancelling the bail granted to the accused-opposite party no. 2 in Case Crime No. 0017 of 2019, under Sections 366, 376 IPC, Police Station Rudhauli, District Basti.

Learned counsel for the applicant-informant submits that the accused-opposite party no.2 was granted bail subject to the conditions contained in the bail order, however, the accused-opposite party no.2 has violated the conditions of the bail and is threatening the witnesses of the case and in this regard, application has also been given by the applicant to the concerned Court below.
Prem Sagar Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160578828/
1

entities.text: Prem Sagar Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. submits that the informant has a remedy available under the Witness Protection Scheme Scheme, 2018 and thus the instant bail cancellation application may be disposed of in the light of protection granted to the witnesses under the Witness Protection Scheme, 2018.

In view of the submissions made by learned A.G.A., this Court is of the opinion, that the applicant has remedy available to him under Witness Protection Scheme, 2018, which scheme has been approved by Hon'ble Apex Court in Mahender Chawla and others Vs. Union of India reported in (2019) 14 SCC 615.

entities.text: Mahender Chawla and others Vs. Union of India reported in (2019) 14 SCC 615
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, present bail cancellation application is disposed of with a direction, in case, the informant-applicant moves appropriate application on the proforma prescribed in the Witness Protection Scheme 2018 alongwith a certified copy of this order for redressal of his grievances, as raised in the instant bail cancellation application, before the competent authority as has been defined under Section 2 (c) of the Witness Protection Scheme, 2018 within a week from today, same shall be considered and decided as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of one month from date of filing such application, strictly in accordance with the Witness Protection Scheme 2018.

Order Date :- 18.8.2023 RPD  Prem Sagar Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160578828/
